component.name: Bindle
component.summary: Set up and optimise this system

description.p: Bindle sets up a fresh Arch-based install the way you want it: it picks drivers, apps and tweaks for your hardware, installs them in one go, and keeps them up to date.
bindleUP checks for updates, runs them in one window and can roll back to a snapshot from Recovery when an update goes wrong.
One update window at a time: a second start brings the open window forward instead of starting a second update.
AUR updates finish in the update window again.
uQview is uQ's picture viewer, pre-selected on first login.
